tool_args.rationale: The observed coupled transient lag and verified mechanism support the two-state siphon-memory ODE, but additional trajectory observations are needed to identify its five parameters before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter coupled siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five pilot rows do not reliably identify five coupled parameters; the mechanism guidance calls for at least eight rows.
It does not resolve the relevant trajectory and parameter-identifiability ambiguity.
Neither is available in the probe menu; the pilot gradient span is not narrow and remains subcritical.
